Name: Splatoon Companions
Author: giraffeyla10
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/65285541-1735175604.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
[center]Hey! Do you like Splatoon? Do you want to see your favourite cephalopod join you on your farm? Then boy do I have the mod for you!

This mod adds the swim forms of multiple characters to the Parrot and Fairy trinkets, plus Smallfry to the Frog Trinket, fully customizable to your preference.[/center]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/65285541-1735175801.png[/img]
[left]﻿
Eight textures for the Parrot and Fairy trinkets.
Seven textures for the Frog trinket.
Ability to enable/disable each trinket separately.
Ability to select which texture you want to use per trinket.
Custom sounds for Parrot trinket on an individual character basis.
Ability to mute Parrot trinket.
Custom texture for the trinket items on an individual character basis.


IMPORTANT!
Upon loading a save file, the fairy trinket may not display as a squid. This is because one fairy texture is selected per save file, and they are stored in odd positions. You must go into the mod options and change the "Fairy Selection" drop down menu to either "One" or "Two". The default is "One".



[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/65285541-1735175667.png[/img]﻿

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url]﻿ (not required, but it allows you to use two trinkets at a time so you can have your favourite duo following you around if you so wish.)
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/65285541-1735175752.png[/img]﻿

1. Download and install Smapi, Content Patcher, and Generic Mod Config Menu.
2. Download Splatoon Companions and unzip into the mod folder
3. Run the game! You can then configure it to your liking through the Mod Config menu.



[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/65285541-1735175635.png[/img]﻿
